g.text: Tall masses form room/corridor boundaries; green low cover supports preparation, ducking and repositioning; central A01/B01 remain.
EL-return and EL-north-return form a real S-connector with2.8m clear passes and a4x8m turning room; no new isolated blocker props.
Gallery is a dogleg floorplate, with2.4m guards except ordinary accesses and marked D01. Low cover bypasses remain3.8m.
A dais+.60: opposite3-riserstairs; east+1.20: paired ramps/crest. Source terrain/cover base elevations must be read in3D.
D01 is optional4m drop into supported Mid; normal return routes are stairs/ramp. No target-engine fall/damage/jump-back proof.
Source/API compile, actual paired images, sampled opaque ray tests and constrained movement are evidence; not multiplayer balance.
Named-space graph: audits/node-graph.svg. Full per-feature ID/footprint ledger: inventory.md. Historical planning drawings remain in audits/.
